messages:
rachel: Heads-up: we're deprecating the legacy rollout script (deploy_legacy.sh) from the release train next month.
omar: What replaces it?
rachel: New CLI: ./redwood-deploy with canary safety hooks and better rollback metadata. Docs: https://confluence.redwood/infra/redwood-deploy (internal).
release-lead: Timeline: soft deprecation starts 2025-10-01, hard removal 2025-11-01. Teams should migrate before the hard date.
sre-oncall: Why the change? Any runtime differences we should watch for?
rachel: Main gains: consistent canary cadence, automatic tagging of rollback reasons, and integrated smoke checks. Runtime behavior identical unless you enable the new auto-abort flags.
omar: Is there an automated migration guide?
rachel: Yes  migration script: ./tools/migrate-to-redwood-deploy --source=deploy_legacy.sh. It converts CI jobs and preserves env var mappings.
infra-bot: Migration checklist added to repo: /docs/migration/redwood-deploy-checklist.md.
release-lead: We'll run a weekly migration office hour starting 2025-09-15 to help teams. Link to calendar invite posted to #eng-calendar.
sre-oncall: Note: any team that enables auto-abort should validate their dashboards; thresholds are stricter by default. We'll provide a test flag --safe-mode to mimic old behavior.
omar: If we hit a regression after switching, what's rollback lead protocol?
release-lead: Rollback lead = deploy owner. Use ./redwood-deploy rollback --to-last and file a short incident note. Oncall will assist for cross-service rollbacks.
rachel: We'll publish changelog entries per-team during migration and tag releases with migration=true so ops can filter.
infra-bot: Deprecation notices will be appended to CI logs for two weeks starting 2025-09-01.
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. We'll also add an alert if a legacy deploy is used after 2025-11-01 to catch stragglers.
release-lead: Thanks all. Please start planning migrations and ping me or rachel if you need help. Tag this thread id 1846000000 for follow-ups.
